# Kleanly 2.2
- Move your license to a new Mac right from the activation window, even if the old Mac is gone. - Reinstalling Kleanly on the same Mac now reactivates without using up your license. - Opening Kleanly from Spotlight or Applications now shows Settings, so you can always find it when the notch control is hidden. - New Share Usage Analytics setting and a link to the privacy policy. - Kleanly now asks before opening at login. - The notch control no longer checks the pointer when your Mac is idle, which saves energy. - On displays without a notch, the control is a small tab that waits a moment before opening. - Granting Accessibility permission no longer starts cleaning on its own. - Added Contact Support to the activation window and About page.

# Kleanly 2.1
- Added the interactive notch control with clear start and stop actions. - Added automatic Sparkle updates with signed downloads. - Added Gumroad license activation for one Mac per purchase. - Added **Deactivate This Mac** so a license can be moved safely. - Refined cleaning animations, feedback, and settings.
